scope: Authorization for one original MKBUnlockDevice(NULL,NULL) call against the freshly created disposable simulated-device system keybag.

provenance.format: IM4P containing an unencrypted LZFSE research kernel payload at byte offset 62
provenance.conversion: lzfse_decode_buffer using the existing pinned build dependency; decoded copy retained outside Git

selector_dispatch.flag_condition: Effective handle is 0 or <= -3; the observed system bag handle is 0.

finding.conclusion: Missing client flag bit 4 rejects this system-bag operation before secret processing and before unlock_the_device. This branch explains the observed selector 9 error without requiring a SEP rejection or a passcode interpretation.

mobilekeybag_mapping.interpretation: The public -2 alone is ambiguous; the adjacent original kernel log specifically identifies e00002e2.

execution_boundary.reported_boot_observation: Boot 7: selector 9 returned e00002e2 adjacent to the one NULL-secret unlock call; MKB returned -2 and first-unlock remained 0.
execution_boundary.next_validation: A separately recorded controlled run may add only this entitlement to owned ad-hoc helper code and repeat one original API call. Success and first-unlock must be established by actual guest results.

limits: Does not claim all possible selector 9 errors originate in this authorization branch.
Does not infer lock-state enum meanings from the malformed simulated GetDeviceState response.
Contains no Apple implementation binaries, complete disassembly, device keys, signatures, or keybag material.
